notes.title: Army of Ruin - Available now!
notes.content:
[h2]Today we're releasing the 1.0 version of Army of Ruin![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019091/4240571054a715b5afcdc45b6f942c3942b126e8.png[/img]


During the past 8 months we've been in Early Access, we've released [b]over 25 updates[/b] adding lots of new content and features, such as [b]24 playable charactes[/b], [b]over 100 weapons and evolutions[/b], and [b]over 60 different trinkets[/b], many of which were based on the community feedback we've got during the whole process.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1918040/extras/ArmyOfRuin_GameplayGif.gif?t=1666864737[/img]

We believe Army of Ruin has become a great game with lots of contents to unlock and lots of fun to have while doing so, and we hope you think the same way, whether you are a new player or a returning backer!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6860297/d27102d66ff5f2301f2d0992186536fb5b1ccebb.jpg[/img]

As always, we're eager to hear suggestions and feedback for future content, be it in the Steam forums, in the official Subreddit, or in the official Discord server!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6860297/e34529c4f4f82c9801c8fd26db52b37d81ab5cfa.jpg[/img]

We're also releasing the official Soundtrack and new bundles to get the game combined with other items (such as our previous games) at a reduced price.

The game will have a 10% discount for the following 10 days, and you can get additional discounts with the themed bundles, such as the Army of Ruin + Soundtrack bundle or Milkstone Complete Collection bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1918040/Army_of_Ruin/

notes.title: Update #61 - Quality of life improvements!
notes.content:
Hi! Today we're releasing an update bringing some improvements to the game, as well as a new item that was requested after the snow event a few weeks ago. Check it out!

[list]
[*]Adde snow ground tile. Now some snow decorations (Igloo and Snowman) use this ground tile.
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Items for the current event (if any) are now highlighted in the map, just like quest items.
[*]The time it takes to load the farm is now simulated once the game is loaded. Should be more noticeable on big farms that took several seconds to load.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #60 - Sweet Tooth Festival compensation
notes.content:
Hi! As you may have noticed, the Sweet Tooth Festival ended approximately a day earlier than expected, because of a bug in the game code that didn't properly manage the year change (happy new year, by the way!).

In order to compensate for this, this update will automatically unlock the next tier that you didn't achieve in the event (as long as you completed at least one tier).

[*]Fixed year change causing event dates to be incorrectly calculated.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]

[list]
[*]Guestbook: Now the items in the log are sorted from newest to oldest. Also you can select each line and see their profile, favorite or block the player.
[*]You can now keep the interaction button held down to work on contiguous tiles while walking. For example when plowing/planting, or when placing roads.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Flowers with grow length over 2 days won't be selected for quests.
[*]Experience: Reduced experience obtained from planting trees, animals and flowers. Increased experience obtained from harvesting them.
[i]Some items were giving too much experience that could be easily exploited by placing and recycling them right away. With this, items give a bit more experience in the long run, without being as exploitable.[/i]
[*]Oyster, Mussel and Clam: Their experience values weren't properly set (they were way too low). Now they have more reasonable values.
[*]Reduced exchange rate for gold nuggets->tickets.
[i]Since farmhands can find gold nuggets, the exchange rate of 5 tickets per nugget meant they could self-sustain and even become a better source of tickets than performing jobs. With this change, they can probably be still self-sustained, but at least it will require more gold nuggets to do so.[/i]

[*]Fixed a possible security exploit that could allow visitors to perform tasks they didn't have permissions for.

[*]Fixed farmhands not showing the money pop-up in the proper place when fishing on Ponds.
[*]Fixed Ducks physics settings that would drop performance severely when many of them were being shown.
[*]Fixed recycling house decorations on top of surfaces not giving any money back.

notes.content:

The most important feature added is the increase of the level cap from 100 to 999. All experience previously obtained will count towards the new cap, so you may go up a number of levels at once if you reached level 100 some time ago.

On top of that, you now have a very slight chance of getting a gold nugget when harvesting items. This chance will increase along with the level of an item.

Gold nuggets can be exchanged in a new building, the Pawn Shop, for other currency and resources.

Hi!

This week's update features some changes to the network and save system, so for now it will only be available for people who opt in to try it. See instructions below.

We've also added a number of new trees, fish, and the gift shop, which allows you to exchange coins for medals (be warned, they are quite expensive!).

[b]Details on the beta update:[/b]
This update brings a new network protocol, using Steam to connect between peers, that should improve connectivity and reduce the number of connection issues (shouldn't have an impact over connection quality and ping once the connection has been established).

We've done our best to make sure it works, but to be on the safe side, we want to do some public testing before completely replacing the older system.

We've also changed the format used for farm save data. This should help with some data corruptions people were experiencing. This should work fine and be compatible with farms saved in the previous format. Again to be on the safe side, some volunteer testing will be appreciated.

Some Q&A on these changes:
[list]
[*][b]How do I opt in?[/b]
To try this update, open the game's properties on the Steam client, go to the Betas tab, and select the "beta" branch. The client will download the update. If the "beta" branch is not shown, please try restarting the Steam client.
[*][b]Will my data be safe?[/b]
We're rather sure it will. If you experience problems please let us know.
[*][b]If I opt in, can I go back later to the previous update?[/b]
You can opt out of the beta, but any farm saved in the new format won't be loaded by previous versions of the game (this has always been the case).
[*][b]If I opt in, will I be able to join people outside the beta?[/b]
No, farms with a different version can't be joined. They won't appear on the farm list and will throw an error if you try to join via invites etc.
[*][b]When will the update become available to everyone?[/b]
Once we have enough data and feedback to make sure it works as expected and no major bugs arise, we'll make it available to everyone. Depending on how many people test it out and how many issues arise, it can be just a few days, or more.
[/list]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed networking protocol to use Steam P2P. This should improve overall connectivity.
[*]Changed save format to a different one. This should help with some save data corruption.
[/list]

notes.title: Farm Together Update #1 - Peanuts & Bugfixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32023457/c2e78d37724ce58216740c9cd8cb7d959d10a504.gif[/img]

Hi! It's a blast to know so many people are playing and enjoying the game :). Of course, not everything went perfect and we got some reports of bugs and annoyances. We've been working hard to address the most important ones.

We're aware of some cases where farm visitors get cloned (Wow!) and others where people are shown out of place, but fortunately the farming itself works. We haven't managed to reproduce or fix that yet, but it's our #1 priority for the next week.

This update also includes a new crop, the Peanut, a level 1 plant that should add some variety to the early farming tasks.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]New crop: Peanut
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]A confirmation dialog is shown when recycling items. This window can be disabled in the Game settings.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Money obtained when recycling is rounded up. For example, selling the basic Fence (1 Diamond) will net you 1 Diamond instead of 0.
[*]Default items created on a new farm will have some growth (50-75%) and water (33%-50%) at the beginning.
[*]Reduced number of repetitions required in the tutorial for the lettuces from 10 to 8.
[*]Increased time it takes for plants to wither to 7 days or 5 times their growth time, whichever value is higher.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Should have fixed issues with the level indicator not updating.
[*]Fixed "Find Farms" section not scrolling with Gamepad/Keyboard
[/list]

We've also added some sections to the forum so you can report bugs, add suggestions, or even show your beatiful farm to the world! Remember to use the Photo mode in the pause menu to take nice pictures :)

Regarding suggestions, we're thinking of a way to make it easier to organize and prioritize suggestions, so we can focus in the most requested ones. We'll keep you informed about this, meanwhile please do use the Forums or the official Discord / Subreddit.
